subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: What proxy/security contract should Feishu SDK HTTP and WS bootstrap use for this issue: ambient/managed proxy by default, an explicit per-channel policy, or documentation-only NO_PROXY guidance?
rationale: Current main is still broken for proxy-required Feishu users, but changing whether credentialed Feishu traffic follows or bypasses operator proxy settings affects both mixed-network compatibility and the security egress boundary.

options.title: Land proxy-aware PR
options.body: Approve Feishu SDK HTTP and WS bootstrap following OpenClaw ambient/managed proxy agents, then land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386 after normal PR review.

options.title: Require per-channel policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for an explicit Feishu proxy mode design before code lands, preserving room for direct-vs-ambient routing in mixed environments.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Reject the runtime change and document NO_PROXY/direct proxy troubleshooting, accepting that affected users must configure environment routing themselves.

recommendation.title: Land proxy-aware PR
recommendation.body: Approve Feishu SDK HTTP and WS bootstrap following OpenClaw ambient/managed proxy agents, then land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386 after normal PR review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared ambient proxy helper and has the strongest recent ownership signal for the proxy boundary touched by the candidate fix.
